title: Add global interface zoom controls
user_summary: 在设置-外观中增加界面缩放，并支持 Ctrl+/-/0；导航栏、正文区域外的整站 UI 同步缩放，正文字号与行距保持独立。
technical_summary: Add browser-like global interface zoom via Tauri Webview.setZoom (CSS zoom fallback). Settings key storylens.appearance.interfaceZoom; levels 80/90/100/110/125/150; default 100; Ctrl+/Ctrl+=/Ctrl-/Ctrl+0; early apply in index.html; reading fontSize/lineHeight remain independent. Targets 1.1.0-rc.2 with STEP 2.8-FIX.
acceptance_criteria: Settings Appearance shows 界面缩放 with 80-150 presets
Ctrl+Plus / Ctrl+Equal / Ctrl+Minus / Ctrl+0 work; clamp at ends
Zoom persists in localStorage and restores on restart
正文字号 and 行距 remain independent

data_compatibility.notes: New localStorage key storylens.appearance.interfaceZoom; invalid values fall back to 100.
